title: Pharmaceutical Drug Spending by countries
name: pharmaceutical-drug-spending
description: Pharmaceutical drug spending by country from 1971 to 2021, with indicators covering share of total health spending, share of GDP, spending in USD per capita (using economy-wide PPPs), and total spending in millions of USD. Data sourced from the OECD and supplemented with UN population figures.

sources.name: oecd-pharmaexp
sources.title: Pharmaceutical Drug Spending from Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development

sources.name: un-population
sources.title: Population data from the datasets/population GitHub repository

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL)

resources.name: data
resources.description: Annual pharmaceutical drug spending per country, combining OECD expenditure data with UN population figures. Each row represents one country-year combination. TOTAL_SPEND is derived by multiplying USD_CAP by the country's population and dividing by 1,000,000.

fields.name: TIME
fields.description: Year of observation in the form YYYY

fields.name: USD_CAP
fields.description: in USD per capita (using economy-wide PPPs)

fields.name: TOTAL_SPEND
fields.description: Total spending in millions of USD, calculated as USD_CAP multiplied by country population divided by 1,000,000
